acceptance: A server bound to https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site.git refuses expect_store BenchBox-dev/BenchBox with the E_STATE gate
A server bound to https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/BenchBox.git accepts BenchBox-dev/BenchBox and BenchBox-dev/BenchBox.git, and refuses BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site
Tests cover HTTPS, SSH (git@github.com:owner/repo.git) and local-path remotes
The vendored wheel in _project/scripts is updated to the fixed release
description:
get_instructions compares expect_store as a case-insensitive substring of the bound state remote. Since BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site gained its own tracker, the value the todo skill tells core sessions to pass, BenchBox-dev/BenchBox, also matches https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site.git. Observed on 2026-10-30 with todo-db 0.11.0 bound to the site store: expect_store BenchBox-dev/BenchBox was accepted, while BenchBox-dev/BenchBox.git and BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site behaved correctly. A core session whose server was started from the site clone would therefore write core items into the site tracker without being refused.

Match owner/repo against the remote's path exactly (ignoring a trailing .git and case), for HTTPS, SSH and local-path remotes. Until that ships, core sessions can pass BenchBox-dev/BenchBox.git.
